references.text: The prohibition against misusing the Lord's name in the third commandment, which the son of the Israelite woman broke by blaspheming God's name
The penalty for blaspheming the Lord's name is death by stoning, as was applied to this man
A similar case where a lawbreaker was held in custody while awaiting the Lord's judgment
Naboth was falsely accused of blaspheming God and the king, and was stoned to death
Job was careful to bless God in case his children had blasphemed God in their hearts
Job's wife tempted him to blaspheme God, in contrast to the blasphemer in Leviticus
God's name is blasphemed among the nations, showing the seriousness of dishonoring God's name
Jesus' warning that blasphemy against the Holy Spirit cannot be forgiven, linked to the gravity of blaspheming what is holy
The high priest accused Jesus of blasphemy, which under Old Testament law deserved death
Stephen was falsely accused of blasphemy against Moses and God
